integrity: All formal identities and a standalone symbolic checker included; no third-party text reproduced; numerical quadrature is not substituted for exact proof.
scientific_limitations: Two explicitly certified strict attracting-period-three windows; not a classification of all eye components or global dynamics. Source first full preprint 2025-10-13; an earlier public seminar announcement (2023-10-27) introduced the family and qualitative context but supplied no full statement of these exact windows. Historical priority and independent validation unresolved.
title: An explicit smallest-period attracting eye in a piecewise-linear doubled circle map
